more.title: Election 2026 | ANC takes early control of three councils, PA punches above its weight
more.description: The ANC has emerged as the first political party to secure control of municipalities in the 2026 local government elections, while the Patriotic Alliance (PA) is outperforming several bigger parties in the allocation of council seats.With 15% of votes counted on Thursday morning, the Electoral Commission’s (IEC) results dashboard showed the ANC controlling three councils and leading in another eight.The ANC had accumulated 120 seats, followed by the DA with 81 and the PA with 26.READ MORE: Momentum builds for ANC to dump DA after municipal electionsThe PA was also leading in one council...
